changes.old: A disjunct with at most one square atom contributes only O(√H) positive integers up to H, so finitely many such disjuncts cannot define the nonsquares.
changes.new: A disjunct with at most one square atom whose solution set contains no rational square contributes only O(√H) positive integers up to H, so finitely many such disjuncts cannot define the nonsquares.

changes.reason: An equation containing x plus witness-only constraints is a simultaneous system, not an unrestricted quadratic image; also specify the nonzero x-coefficient case.

changes.old: At p=2, m is divisible by 4 and x≡1 mod16, hence x is a 2-adic square. One may verify the latter directly by lifting odd roots: an odd root modulo 2^k, k≥3, can be changed by 2^{k-1} to select the required next bit of its square; the compatible lifts yield a 2-adic root. In particular the standard square criterion 1 mod8 applies.
changes.new: At p=2, m is divisible by 4 and x≡1 mod16. The standard criterion that a 2-adic unit congruent to 1 modulo 8 is a square applies.
changes.reason: Remove a root-adjustment aside that did not preserve the chosen residue modulo 2^k; use the standard correct 2-adic unit criterion.
